observations: Neural crest stem cells from hair follicles and boundary cap have different effects on pancreatic islets in vitro.

entities.name: NCSC source-specific islet effect
observations: In mouse islet co-cultures, both hair-follicle and boundary-cap NCSCs migrated extensively, but only boundary-cap cells showed directed migration toward islets, induced β-cell proliferation, and increased cadherin at NCSC–β-cell junctions.
